Success: The Living Digital Twin

We have successfully upgraded the core engine from a standard simulator into a Living Digital Twin. This means it can now learn and adapt in real-time by taking in "Ground Truth Data", such as actual measurements from the field like automated weather station readings, drone imagery, or notes from scouting teams.

Instead of just guessing what might happen based on its starting settings, the system constantly checks itself against reality. Whenever new data comes in (like an updated leaf count or soil moisture reading), the engine instantly corrects its internal math to match the real world. This ensures our future forecasts are always perfectly grounded in what is actually happening on the farm today.
